instruction: Look at pump_housing_rotated.dxf. Draw a pump housing layout with a volute outer circle centered at (70,70) radius 55 on OUTLINE, impeller cutout circle centered at (70,70) radius 25 on CUTOUT, outlet rectangle from (120,55) to (180,85) on OUTLINE, base rectangle from (20,0) to (140,25), base holes at (40,12.5) and (120,12.5) with radius 4, and text ACAD-20 on ANNOTATION. Use OUTLINE for the volute outer circle, outlet rectangle, and base rectangle; use CUTOUT for the impeller cutout circle; use HOLE for base holes. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
